notes: Lisboa makes a wide range of wines: red, white, rosé, sparkling, fortified and the light Leve.
Lisboa Leve is low in alcohol, with fruity or floral aromas and a tart, fresh taste.

blurb.text: One of Portugal's largest wine producers by volume, a regional wine area covering the Atlantic strip north of the Tagus estuary, from Lisbon up to the Beira region. Caladoc, Castelão, Fernão Pires and Syrah are the most planted grapes.
